Bumps [actions/download-artifact](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact) from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/download-artifact's releases.

v8.0.2

What's Changed

  • Update the readme by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#473
  • Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.
  • Update @​actions/artifact to 6.3.1 by @​tunc-d in actions/download-artifact#492
  • Prepare download-artifact v8.0.2 by @​tunc-d in actions/download-artifact#493

New Contributors

  • @​tunc-d made their first contribution in actions/download-artifact#492

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/compare/v8.0.1...v8.0.2
